results.question: I joined on 1 September 2026 and I'm on probation. Can I take 8 days of EL in December?
results.answer:
No – while you’re still on probation you may use a maximum of 6 days of Earned Leave, so 8 days in December isn’t allowed.  

- You can only take up to 6 EL days during the first 6 months of employment [HR-LV-001].  
- Leave must be applied in PeopleHub → Leave → Apply Leave and approved by your manager [HR-LV-001].  
- Because the leave would be more than 3 consecutive working days, you must submit the request at least 7 calendar days before the start date [HR-LV-001].
